name: MoLOX (Magnaporthe oryzae lipoxygenase), WT glycosylated
notes: UniProt G4NAP4 given in the paper (footnote 'Protein Identifier'); UniProt organism Pyricularia oryzae strain 70-15 (paper names no strain); EC from UniProt (paper gives none). Expressed in P. pastoris X-33, N-glycosylated (heterogeneous). Paper numbering = UniProt minus 14 (= 5FNO author numbering): paper N18, N28, N48, N72, N150, N215, N501, N535, L331, F332 = UniProt N32, N42, N62, N86, N164, N229, N515, N549, L345, F346 (all checked). 5FNO (Wennman et al. 2016 JBC, 10.1074/jbc.M115.707380 = S060 ref 22) is the Endo H-treated enzyme (glycans trimmed to GlcNAc); its chain covers UniProt 15-619 with N-terminal EF (RCSB alignment V15E/A16F, within the signal peptide 1-16, cloning remnant). S060 names no PDB ID; no entry cites S060's DOI.

name: GLN MoLOX (all eight N-glycan Asn -> Gln)
